notes:
A new look: one window with your cues on the left, the cue in the middle and what CueLevel will do on the right.
Before levelling, CueLevel shows each step it plans (trim, even out, repairs, gain) with a tick box to skip any of them, and predicts the result.
A big loudness readout shows where the cue is now, where it will land and the target, on one ruler.
Colour now means level everywhere: blue is quiet, green is on target, amber is changed, red is too hot.
Prepare and Edit modes: Edit opens the clip gain editor (⌘E).
Show settings (⌘,) gathers loudness, files, references and processing in one place.
Lossless gain-only levelling is now the default file type.
New icon.
